# Mahagauri v0 — has the server really returned to normal?

**SMD (Server Machine Dataset)** (NetManAIOps/OmniAnomaly @ `7fb0e0acf89e`): 327 real incidents with an hour of clean history before them. From each incident's first minute until 60 minutes after it ends, the verifier answers once a minute whether the server has recovered. It declares *all clear* at the first of 3 consecutive yeses. Each machine group is held out in turn, and every threshold is set on the other groups so that premature all-clears stay at or below 5% there.

## How to read this

- A **premature all-clear** is the error that matters: the incident is declared over while it continues. A verifier that never declares anything has a premature rate of zero and is useless, so read the confirmed share next to it.
- *Back within 3σ* is what a hand-written check amounts to: every metric back near its pre-incident level. The *fixed timer* waits for the median incident length seen in training.
- SMD's labels mark when operators judged each anomaly over. Those labels are the ground truth here, and they inherit the operators' judgement.
- Designed, written and trained by an AI assistant under the owner's direction ([adr/RealDataModels](../../adr/RealDataModels.md)).
